proposal.summary: Runtime is NOT ready to continue autonomously. The roadmap execution queue (7 missions, from PREFLIGHT through FREEZE_RUNTIME) has been fully QUEUED and untouched since 2026-07-12; the next pending mission is order 1 PREFLIGHT (Repository Preflight), reported status READY. Prerequisites for downstream work are largely in place — build-order.json marks the ProjectContext Engine as READY with valid reuse targets (decision/knowledge/patch/validation engines) — but a hard blocker sits upstream of all of it: the mission state machine cannot advance. All 37 mission-ledger entries (FLEET_PIPE_SMOKE, FLEET_TEST, M0015) are recorded in state CREATED with nextStates=[QUALIFIED], and zero have ever transitioned to QUALIFIED, IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, or COMPLETE. The runtime can author and register missions but cannot progress their lifecycle, so no roadmap mission can be executed to completion unattended. Autonomous execution is BLOCKED until the CREATED→QUALIFIED transition (mission qualification/state-advance step) is repaired. No files were read-only inspected; nothing was modified.
actions: Analyzed roadmap state: read runtime/generated/mission-queue.json (7 missions, all QUEUED) and current-mission.json (PREFLIGHT, READY, QUEUED)
Identified next pending mission as order 1 PREFLIGHT (Repository Preflight)
Verified downstream prerequisites via build-order.json (ProjectContext Engine READY; reuse targets present)
Inspected mission-ledger.json: 37 entries, 100% in state CREATED, none advanced to QUALIFIED+
Determined BLOCKING ISSUE: mission state machine cannot advance past CREATED, halting autonomous execution
Concluded runtime is BLOCKED and cannot continue the roadmap autonomously without fixing the CREATED→QUALIFIED transition
